crossRefs.note: “You, son of man, tell the children of your people, ‘The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him in the day…
When I tell the righteous that he will surely live; if he trusts in his righteousness, and commits iniquity, none of…
When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies therein; in his iniquity that…
Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and…
For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ…
But the righteous will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”

translations.web: When the righteous turns from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, he will even die therein.
translations.bsb: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will die for it.
translations.kjv: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die
translations.asv: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die therein.
